title: Successful sign-in after password spray pattern
analyst_next_step: Treat as potential account compromise: validate authentication/MFA, session and device context; escalate and seek approval for session revocation or account reset.

title: Multi-account password spray pattern
analyst_next_step: Validate the source and user activity; inspect Conditional Access/MFA and associated sign-ins; request identity containment approval if suspicious.

title: Account added to a security-enabled group
analyst_next_step: Verify group sensitivity and approved change ticket; contact the identity owner. Do not remove membership automatically without authorization.

title: Potentially suspicious PowerShell execution
analyst_next_step: Review the parent process, script content if available, execution context, Defender timeline and approved administration activity before containment.
